records.question: Angela has a collection of 24 pieces of rare action figures. She sold off a quarter of them at the pawnshop and gave one-third of the remainder to her daughter. How many does she have left?
records.response:
She sold 24*1/4 = 6 action figures.
She had 24-6 = 18 action figures left.
She gave 18*1/3 = 6 action figures to her daughter.
She had 18-6 = 12 action figures left.

records.question: A frog pond has five frogs living in it. Some frogs laid eggs, and now there are three times as many tadpoles growing into more frogs as there are frogs. Two-thirds of the tadpoles will survive to maturity as frogs. The pond can only sustain eight frogs. How many frogs will have to find a new pond when the tadpoles grow up?
records.response:
There are 5 frogs in the pond, so 3 * 5 = 15 tadpoles are growing into frogs.
Two-thirds of the tadpoles will survive, so 2/3 * 15 = 10 tadpoles will grow into frogs.
The pond can only sustain 8 frogs, so 10 - 8 = 2 frogs will have to find a new pond.
